source.author: verg
source.text: Sic ait, et dicto citius tumida aequora placat, collectasque fugat nubes, solemque reducit.
source.text_original: Sic ait, et dicto citius tumida aequora placat, / collectasque fugat nubes, solemque reducit.
source.text_english: Thus he spoke, and quicker than the word he calmed the swollen waters, drove away the gathered clouds, and brought back the sun.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: haec ait et pontum pater ac turbata reponit litora depellitque Notos, quos caerulus horror et madido gravis unda sinu longeque secutus imber ad Aeoliam tendunt simul aequore portam.
reuse.text_original: ' / haec ait et pontum pater ac turbata reponit / litora depellitque Notos, quos caerulus horror / et madido gravis unda sinu longeque secutus / imber ad Aeoliam tendunt simul aequore portam.
reuse.text_english: He spoke thus, and the father calmed the sea and restored the disturbed shores, and drove away the South Winds, which the blue gloom and the heavy wave with its dripping fold and the rain, long following them, were hurrying together to Aeolia straight across the sea’s gate.
